# Canvas for AI

> Tools for editable designs and listening to text.

- [Tool data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai/main/catalog.json): tasks, access, example_prompt, example_url.
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai/main/AGENTS.md).
- [UI Design Editor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai/main/tools/ui-design-editor.md): editable designs. Try https://uidesigneditor.com/.
- [PDF TO MP3 Canvas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai/main/tools/pdf-to-mp3.md): send text through its public API; no account or plugin. Try https://pdftomp3.com/canvas/?example=1. Guide: https://pdftomp3.com/canvas/guide.html.
